summary: A link styled as a button, for a call or the next step.

props.name: href
props.description: A site path, or tel: or mailto: built from site.phone or site.email.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible text, read from a site field.

props.name: variant
props.description: primary for the one main action, secondary for the rest.

constraints: Renders nothing when href or label is empty.
A phone label goes through phoneText from src/phone.ts; the tel link keeps site.phone.
At most one primary per group of actions.
forbidden: a literal label, phone number or email address
a link to a page not in src/pages

summary: Where the business works, the places it names and a short local paragraph.

props.name: heading
props.description: The h2, off the service area page.

constraints: Reads areaTowns, areaBody, areaLink, serviceAreaText and serviceArea. areaTowns lists only places service_area.text names, one to a line; empty shows service_area.text as given.
Off the service area page it links there with areaLink.
forbidden: a place, landmark or travel time the facts do not give

summary: Phone, email, weekday hours and service area, each with its icon, as a list or as cards.

props.name: variant
props.description: cards on the contact page, list elsewhere.

constraints: Reads site.phone, site.email, site.weekdayHours and site.serviceAreaText (else site.serviceArea) itself; each row renders only when its field is set.
The list suits the footer and the quote page; the contact page uses cards.
forbidden: passing contact details as props or children

summary: A closing band with a heading, a line and the site's main action.
constraints: Reads ctaHeading, ctaBody and ctaLabel; renders nothing until the heading or the body is set. The links come from the pages that exist and the phone fact. An empty ctaLabel takes the label of the page it links to, which is the quote page when there is one.
Last on a page, after everything else.
forbidden: an offer, discount or deadline

summary: Questions and answers, each one a native disclosure that needs no script.
constraints: Reads faqItems from src/structured-data.ts, which reads faq1Question to faq8Answer; an entry needs both halves to render. Six to eight when the facts answer that many.
A page that shows it passes faqPage() to Base's jsonLd, so the FAQPage data matches the questions on the page.
forbidden: an answer stating a price, hour or guarantee no fact carries
FAQPage data on a page that does not show the questions

summary: The owner's photos, each with the alt text its fact gives.
constraints: Path and alt text are both fact fields; a photo renders only when it has both. The site ships with none.
Two or more photos are cropped tiles in a grid; one photo is a single contained figure, never a full-width image.
forbidden: a path or alt text written here
a stock or remote image

summary: The page's h1 with a lede and action links; on the home page the template sets its composition.

props.name: heading
props.description: The page's h1, from a site field.

props.name: lede
props.description: A sentence or two under it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short line above it, as site.industry.

props.name: variant
props.description: home on the home page, page elsewhere.

props.name: image
props.description: The home photo, shown with both halves.

props.name: highlights
props.description: Services shown when there is no photo.

constraints: One per page, first inside the layout.
Children are ActionLink elements only.
home on the home page, page everywhere else. The home hero follows site.template, with the copy beside the photo, the photo full-bleed behind it, or oversized type over stacked blocks.
With no photo the home hero shows highlights, the first three services with their icons, never an empty box.
Renders nothing when the heading, the lede and the actions are all empty.
eyebrow is for the home page, with site.industry.
image is the home page's, from site.heroImage and site.heroImageAlt; it renders only with both, and the same photo is not used again on the page.
forbidden: a second Hero on a page
literal text in heading or lede

summary: One phosphor icon from src/icons.ts, decorative, beside a visible label.

props.name: name
props.description: A key of ICONS in src/icons.ts.

constraints: Renders nothing for a name src/icons.ts does not hold.
Hidden from screen readers, so the text beside it carries the meaning.
The cards draw their icons from their icon fields; use Icon directly only in a page, as the service area page does.
forbidden: an icon as the only label of a link or button
an SVG or icon library added to the site

summary: The quote request form, the visitor's contact details and then the owner's own questions.
constraints: Asks for name, email and phone, labelled by quoteNameLabel, quoteEmailLabel and quotePhoneLabel, then the questions in src/quote-form.json under quoteRequestLegend.
src/quote-form.json is the list the owner approved. The platform writes it; never edit it or this file to change the questions.
Sends to quoteFormAction when set, else by email to site.email; renders nothing with neither. Leave quoteFormAction empty until the platform gives an endpoint.
On the quote page, after its Hero.
forbidden: a price, a range or a promise of how soon a reply comes
a field asking for payment or card details
a script or a third-party form service

summary: A titled block of page content below the hero.

props.name: heading
props.description: The section's h2, read from a site field.

constraints: Wrap it in the condition its content needs, so an empty section never renders.
forbidden: a Section with no content
literal text in heading

summary: The page head, with title, description, canonical URL, Open Graph and JSON-LD.

props.name: title
props.description: The page's own title; the business name is appended once.

props.name: description
props.description: The meta description, from a site field.

props.name: noindex
props.description: Keeps the page out of search results, as the 404 page does.

constraints: The Base layout renders it; a page passes these props to Base.
JSON-LD comes from src/structured-data.ts and is LocalBusiness, Service, WebSite or FAQPage only.
A page's title and description come from its own fields (servicesTitle, servicesDescription and so on), unique to the page; the business name is appended to a title that does not already carry it.
forbidden: using it outside the Base layout
JSON-LD built outside src/structured-data.ts
ratings, reviews or aggregateRating

summary: The services, as linked cards on the home page or a full section each on the services page.

props.name: variant
props.description: cards on home, sections on the services page.

constraints: Reads serviceItems from src/structured-data.ts (service1Name to service6For); a service renders only with a name or a body.
A card shows Name, Body and Icon and links to its section, id service-N, on the services page. A section adds Includes, one item to a line, For, and a quote link.
Each serviceNIcon is a key of ICONS in src/icons.ts, no key twice.
forbidden: a price
a service the facts give no sign of

summary: The footer in columns, the business with its line and quote link, the pages, and the contact details.
constraints: The Base layout renders it on every page.
Every part comes from a field and vanishes when that field is empty.
Shows the owner's logo in place of the business name when site.logo and site.logoAlt are both set, as the header does.
forbidden: using it in a page

summary: The sticky header with the business name, navigation, a phone menu and one call to action.
constraints: The Base layout renders it on every page.
Navigation and the action come from src/routes.ts, so a link shows only when its page exists and its label field is set.
The owner's logo (site.logo with site.logoAlt) replaces the business name at a fixed height; with no logo the name shows as text.
On a phone the links sit behind a native details menu labelled navMenu, which needs no script.
forbidden: using it in a page
a hard-coded navigation link

summary: How working with the business goes, as numbered steps.
constraints: Reads step1Title to step3Body itself; a step renders only when one of its two fields is set. The numbers are drawn by CSS, not written into a field.
forbidden: a time, price or promise no fact states

summary: Reviews quoted from the facts, with the reviewer's name.
constraints: Quote and author are both fact fields. A quote is rendered as the fact gives it, unedited and untrimmed.
forbidden: a review written here
editing or shortening a quote

summary: A band under the home hero with the business's figures and up to three proof points.
constraints: Figures are fact fields (statYearsValue, statClientsValue, statRatingValue); one with no value does not render.
trust1 to trust3 restate business.proof in under six words each, and stay empty without it.
Renders nothing when there are no figures and no points.
forbidden: a figure or point no fact states

summary: Up to three reasons to choose the business, each an icon, a title and a sentence, on one panel.
constraints: Reads valueProp1Title to valueProp3Icon itself, in order; an entry renders only when its title or body is set.
Each valuePropNIcon is a key of ICONS in src/icons.ts that fits the reason; an empty or unknown one shows checkCircle.
Renders nothing when every title and body is empty.
forbidden: a number, rating, award or guarantee no fact states
